title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.18395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-enabled smart homes are becoming more common across the grid edge. However, there has not been much work on failure response. This area is critical because smart homes operate on the grid edge where failures can cascade down. If a power outage happens within a smart home, a user has to manually troubleshoot their smart home to include tasks such as power load balance and device recovery. We conduct the first resilience analysis of smart home agents across a full power outage, providing a suite of outage simulations in a live environment that measures resilience before, during, and post power outage. We show that smart home agents can act as grid operators in power outages and identify several new failure categories highlighting the current limitations across all of our models. These findings establish the groundwork for smart home agents as grid operators to increase overall resilience on the grid edge.

translated_title: 智能家居代理可以成为有能力但不可预测的电网运营商
translated_abstract: 由AI赋能的智能家居在电网边缘正变得越来越普遍。然而，关于故障响应的研究工作还很少。这一领域至关重要，因为智能家居运行在电网边缘，故障可能在此处级联扩散。如果智能家居内部发生停电，用户必须手动排查智能家居的故障，包括电力负载平衡和设备恢复等任务。我们首次对智能家居代理在完整停电过程中的韧性进行了分析，提供了一套在真实环境中运行的停电模拟，用以测量停电前、停电中以及停电后的韧性表现。我们展示了智能家居代理能够在停电时充当电网运营商，并识别出几种新的故障类别，揭示了当前所有模型存在的局限性。这些发现为智能家居代理作为电网运营商以提升电网边缘整体韧性奠定了基础。
tldr: 本文首次对智能家居代理在完整停电过程中的韧性进行分析，证明其可以在停电时充当电网运营商，同时识别出多种新的故障类别，为提升电网边缘整体韧性奠定了基础。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first resilience analysis of smart home agents across a full power outage, demonstrating they can act as grid operators while identifying several new failure categories that establish groundwork for enhancing grid-edge resilience.
